title: Insurance moves: Marsh Risk, Allianz Retire, Sparke Helmore
full_text:
Three Australian insurance sector organisations have announced senior appointments and promotions this week, with the two individual hires each traceable to specific and documented market conditions rather than routine succession.
Marsh Risk has appointed Justin Gillingham (pictured) as head of strata, bringing more than 20 years of insurance and risk management experience across Australia and the UK. Gillingham most recently served as general manager in Marsh's public sector practice. The appointment arrives as the strata insurance market confronts a specific and well-documented set of pressures: deferred maintenance and governance failures at owners corporation level are driving premium increases and creating coverage challenges for strata managers and committee members poorly equipped to manage escalating insurance risk. Gillingham will lead Marsh's strata business as clients face changing property risks and growing demand for support around asset protection and resident safety - a remit that reflects how far the strata broking role has expanded beyond placement into risk advisory and governance support.
Allianz Retire+ has appointed Rachel Elfverson as state manager for Queensland, expanding its distribution capability for retirement income products at a moment of specific commercial momentum. Uptake of the company's Allianz Guaranteed Income for Life product has increased 31% since January 2026 - a growth rate that gives the Queensland distribution expansion its specific commercial rationale rather than treating it as a routine geographic addition.
Elfverson joins from AMP, where she was new business manager for the North platform, bringing more than 30 years of experience across wealth management, distribution and relationship management, with prior roles at VGI Partners, Pengana Capital Group and Australian Unity. She has served as president of Women in Finance Queensland and currently sits on FINSIA's Queensland Regional Council. Chief distribution and marketing officers Catherine van der Veen and Lucy Foster said Elfverson's deep industry experience and strong adviser relationships would support the company's adviser engagement strategy as demand for retirement income solutions grows.
The appointment follows Kiru Anantharaj joining as senior manager of retirement solutions, giving the Allianz Retire+ distribution build its specific team expansion context.
Law firm Sparke Helmore has promoted 46 lawyers effective July 1, 2026, comprising three new partners and 43 promotions to special counsel and senior associate across insurance-related and other practices. The three partner promotions are Stephanie Barclay from the Specialty Lines practice, where she specialises in professional indemnity and financial lines claims advising insurers on indemnity, defence costs and claims management; Ben Gottlieb from the Workplace team, covering employment, industrial relations, workplace safety and regulatory compliance; and Alexandra Kuczerawy from the Casualty team, representing domestic and international insurers across public liability, property damage, product liability and coverage matters. All three are based in Sydney.
The broader promotion round spans Statutory Lines Insurance, CTP Insurance, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Workplace and Government Public and Regulatory practices - a distribution across insurance lines that reflects the firm's depth in both personal injury and specialty insurance litigation.
